note: Dave the Diver x Core Keeper crossover, 30 Nov. Footage is each game's own Steam trailer; neither is the crossover trailer (that one is on YouTube, not downloadable). Our bed because two games' trailer sounds cannot share one track. picture: both Steam trailers, no earlier Reel on this story.
spoken: تتعاون Core Keeper مع لعبة Dave the Diver في تحديث يصل في 30 نوفمبر. ستضيف Core Keeper مشهدًا جديدًا باسم Blue Hole وحيوانين أليفين وسلاحًا ودرعًا وتاجرًا. وفي المقابل تصل غزوة مخلوقات Caveling إلى لعبة Dave the Diver.
bed_reason: Core Keeper 'Riders of the Underground' trailer carries the music of an earlier update and Dave the Diver 'Dive In Now' the sound of a different game; one trailer track cannot sit under shots from both, so our bed
